title: Governed timeline HTTP write
summary: One HTTP patch uses exact revision and execution authority around the timeline document vocabulary. Writes remain Lumeri-only and are not eligible replacement commits today.

carrier.notes: Gate execution_id is execution_ plus the first 32 hex characters of SHA-256 over canonical product/account/session/root-turn/turn/capability/resource-scope data. Scope includes project_revision and authorization context. A proven-not-started step terminalizes RELEASED; the identical request replays its failed outcome, rather than running again.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/timeline/patch
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. HTTP 200 success, 202 approval pending, 409 stale/empty history/denied/cancelled and 500 other Gate failure. Invalid envelopes map to invalid_request. Pure patch vocabulary is iface:timeline.document/v1. Governance failure codes remain open; no guessed closed set. Successful new writes advance Project and Session revisions; exact durable replay does not. Undo/redo prechecks may prevent replay. Staged intent, Project document/revision files and effect-result journal are separate, not one atomic client_op_id commit.

invariants.text: Project and Session access is resolved using verified account identity; a path id alone supplies no ownership authority.
A successful governed patch advances the Project revision. An identical insert request replays without a second edit; undo/redo have a pre-gate availability limitation recorded below.
A fresh request naming a stale Project revision is refused with HTTP 409 before the Project changes.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: The current broker serializes a document edit with its revision under a mutation lease, but writes document.json and project.json separately. It has no single crash-atomic client_op_id result-record commit. It is not yet eligible for replaceable writes under the self-Luc run gate.
upsert_asset, segment_edit, duplicate_clip and remove_track are explicitly unported and refused. A replacement must not silently add them to this major.
The history byte target is not an absolute maximum: one newest snapshot is retained even if it alone exceeds 1048576 bytes.
Track locked and muted are stored settings; apply_patch does not use locked as a write authorization check. Split also does not check the 4096 insertion ceiling.
The execution journal stores immutable effect results separately from Project persistence. It does not make the Project document, revision and client_op_id result record one atomic commit.

Undo/redo availability is checked before Gate replay lookup. After undo consumes the final undo snapshot, an identical retry can return nothing_to_undo rather than replaying its successful receipt; redo has the symmetric limitation.

approval.description: Approval governed by the machinery area; see iface:execution.gate/v1.
